What makes a real estate company good to work for near a small county seat

Four things, in roughly this order: support (training, a manager who isn't competing against you, real systems), economics (your take-home after every fee, not the headline split), culture (do people stay?), and reach (does the company's footprint actually cover the county you're working, not just one town?). A high split at a firm with no real presence anywhere near Bunnell is rarely the best place to work, only the best place to pay fees while covering ground alone.

Why Adams, Cameron & Co. ranks for agents covering the Bunnell area

Bunnell is the seat of Flagler County, small and historic, sitting inside one of the fastest-growing counties in Florida. Adams, Cameron & Co. has been the area's largest brokerage since 1963, with around 300 agents and offices across Volusia and Flagler County, including the Palm Coast office a short drive from Bunnell. Agents cite the non-competing managers, the included marketing and technology, the training, and a genuine family culture that has held together across more than sixty years and a territory far larger than any single town. That's why it appears on third-party “best places to work” lists. If support and countywide reach matter to you in a market anchored by a small, close-knit county seat, it's the established full-service choice.
